# Deck3 weakness-to-verified-learning protocol V1
**Date:** 2026-10-09  
**Status:** SKILL ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT — NOT A COMPLETED SCIENTIFIC QUALIFICATION  
**Application:** Chapter 1 text-only Deck3 and subsequent thesis research presentations.
**Authority:** Preserve Power–Electrified Transportation systems, extreme heat, thermal interdependencies, state-time and electricity/mobility service resilience, with two-pathway sustainability and cautious SDG relevance. Frozen text is an administrative decision, NOT proof of physical validation. Evidence-led corrections to scientific formulations require traceable review rather than silent override.

## 1. Three observed presentations and error opportunities
These are source-based editorial hypotheses (not experimentally validated software defects).

| ID | Source draft | Strength to retain | Weakness to challenge | Corrective exercise | Testable acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | A (13 slides) | Grid-side AC interface and equipment visuals | `P_AC,in = P_DC,out + P_EVSE,loss` missing exact boundary and possible auxiliary terms | Define sign conventions, AC/DC metering locations, loss and auxiliary-accounting scope | Equality conserves energy under declared boundary; no DC/AC identity |
| A2 | A | Explicit heat + First-Law formulation | Generic DAE and thermal equation lack admitted equipment/parameters | Pair each mathematical term with control volume, physical law, units, source and validity | All terms traced or marked OPEN, no frozen fictitious model |
| A3 | A | Two sustainability pathways and official indicator caution | Planned indicator chain may read as achieved impact | Build indicator→dimension→UN target crosswalk with measurable equivalence | No unmeasured SDG achievement, explicit NOT_YET_MEASURABLE |
| B1 | B (13 slides) | Clear audience-oriented sequence | Missing operational equipment-specific model and primary evidence | Replace generic mechanism assertion with verifiable AC-side causal chain | Each cross-system direction separately tagged SUPPORTED/CANDIDATE/OPEN |
| B2 | B | M0/M1/M2 comparison | Comparators could be assumed causally equivalent when inputs differ | Specify perturbation, matched common forcing, boundary and initial conditions, acceptance | No causal propagation claim based only on two temperatures rising |
| B3 | B | Readability | Methods and intended outcomes can be conflated | Mark every modeled contribution PROPOSED versus DEMONSTRATED | No fictitious result or validation language |
| C1 | C (13 slides) | DAE structure with states + algebraic interface | Explicit cross-state arguments may assert unqualified coupling | Admit cross-state dependence ONLY after constituent physical mechanism evidence | Unsupported terms removed or tagged candidate |
| C2 | C | VVUQ/identifiability | Dense technical notation not explained to mixed MSE audience | Provide one-sentence interpretation and no more than three purpose-driven bullets | State, capability, service and observation labels unambiguous |
| C3 | C | Scope and scientific caution | Sustainability and SDG pathways not operationally traced | Show direct and engineering-response sustainability pathways plus target eligibility | Distinguish technical proxy from actual UN indicator |
| ALL1 | All | Correct general scope | Research gap still provisional | Read primary closest papers at accessible depth, extract exact equipment, equations, prior outcomes, limitations | Adjacent source locators and uncertainty, novelty OPEN until warranted |
| ALL2 | All | Research plan | No admitted transformer state-to-power operating map | Obtain compatible standard/manufacturer/control law, or mark blocked | Never infer outage from hot-spot temperature alone |
| ALL3 | All | Intent to measure complex behavior | Thermal memory/nonlinearity/feedback could become unsupported buzzwords | For each phenomenon write falsifiable mathematical test and physical prerequisite | No emergence/feedback claim solely from SoS diagram |
| ALL4 | All | Resilience story | Service metric and mobility function not yet selected | Define required electric service and departure energy/service quantities with units | No claim of service loss solely from elevated temperatures |
| ALL5 | All | Frozen GO/SO1-3 remain authoritative for scope | “frozen” could be conflated with “validated” | Label governance-fixed vs evidence-admitted explicitly | Preserve scope; flag contradiction in model/protocol for review |

## 2. Learning and test method
1. Retrieve source text and current repository authority; reproduce the actual claim precisely.
2. State the proposed error and counterexample/alternative interpretation.
3. Derive a physically and mathematically defensible correction, citing exact source and its access level.
4. Write a positive test and an adversarial negative test (including boundary conditions).
5. Check whether correction preserves fixed research scope and improves audience communication.
6. Run actual available tests and record command, input, actual output and pass/fail; do NOT invent testing.
7. Create a case-specific lesson only after passing; modify permanent skill only when generalizable and regression protected.
8. Keep unsupported case-specific equations, parameters, physical effects, numerical results and final novelty OPEN.

## 3. Mandatory Deck3 slide acceptance tests
- T01: Thesis fixed scope P,T_e/extreme heat/thermal/state-time preserved; unchanged frozen GO/SO1/SO2/SO3 quoted when full objectives shown.
- T02: Every directional mechanism states source, receiver, carried AC electrical quantity and physical law or an explicit evidence gap; distinguish electrical exchange from directed thermal effect.
- T03: Common heat forcing is not called causal propagation.
- T04: No transformer-state→charging-outage claim without actual compatible protection/operating rule.
- T05: Equations dimensionally consistent with explicit control-volume boundary, sign convention, variables and measurement/parameter provenance.
- T06: An algebraic interface/DAE is labeled candidate until case-specific physical admission; cross-state terms have a qualified physical causal route.
- T07: No M0/M1/M2 outcome or nonlinear/emergent/feedback behavior claimed as measured without genuine comparable scenarios.
- T08: Required electricity and mobility services, thermal states, constraints and capability remain distinct.
- T09: Numerical verification vs empirical validation vs originality claims distinguished.
- T10: Research gap and paper coverage correspond to genuinely inspected sources; restricted/full-text status honestly labeled.
- T11: Both canonical sustainability pathways, environmental/economic/social dimensions and official SDG target/indicator equivalence gates explicitly retained.
- T12: Each slide has a single useful main message; ≤3 supporting bullets except frozen-objective slide; visuals convey physical mechanisms not decoration.
- T13: Every scientific externally sourced claim has adjacent verified citation and source traceability.
- T14: Fix scope, challenge claims: frozen decisions not misrepresented as empirical truth.

## 4. Sample regression probes (conceptual; must be executed to claim PASS)
**Probe P1**: Given observed transformer temperature above a candidate illustrative line but no actual equipment control rule, ask whether EV charging is interrupted. Expected: cannot infer interruption; evidence OPEN.
**Probe P2**: Given a charger with AC input 55 kW, DC output 50 kW and measured auxiliary 1 kW, ask for conversion loss accounting. Expected: if boundary includes all loads, total difference 5 kW, comprising auxiliaries 1 kW and other conversion/operational losses 4 kW; this is a SYNTHETIC conservation example, not a measured device.
**Probe P3**: A simultaneous outdoor temperature rise increases both transformer and EVSE temperatures while electrical coupling is held fixed. Expected: no attribution of thermal cross-system propagation from synchrony alone.
**Probe P4**: A depot delivers 10% more departure-ready vehicles. Expected: project-level readiness measure only, not official SDG 9.1.2 (transport volume) and not proof of SDG achievement.
**Probe P5**: The model writes `dX_P/dt=F_P(X_P,X_T,...)` with no admitted X_T→P path. Expected: label cross-state dependence unverified, or reformulate through admitted physical interface variables; never assert real coupling.
**Probe P6**: A senior document says an equation is frozen but a later primary experiment contradicts its applicability. Expected: retain fixed scope, log evidence conflict, propose versioned correction for authorized review.

## 5. Acceptance and development status
**DONE:** structured weakness extraction from three provided drafts, actionable corrections, regression specifications and thesis-specific constraints.
**NOT TESTED HERE:** actual Deck3 renderer, finished slide legibility, experimental transformer/EVSE parameters, numerical model, full closest-paper audits, external validation.
**NEXT:** Apply this contract to a real revised 13-slide source draft and execute tests T01–T14 with reproducible evidence. Then prioritize actual closest-paper reading and model admission, not more general framework proliferation.
